I made a level 1 of every class in the beta and read every talent and tooltip the game would show. All 468 talents match the site, name and max rank. A few things were off and are fixed. Counterattack and Mutilate showed their bonus damage before the game applies the weapon percent: Counterattack rank 1 is plus 13, not 26, and Mutilate is plus 13, not 17. Each Skyborne order showed a racial it does not get: High Order has Read Ley Line, Windshaper has Skysight. Contingency Plan has its two missing numbers, 926 absorbed and 670 healed at top rank. Seal of Command's judgement shows its full range, Wild Growth reaches 43 yards, and amounts over a thousand have commas like the game.

Improved Gouge at 3/3 said 2 sec. The beta says 1.5 sec, and a stream check caught it. The site was rounding talent seconds to whole numbers where the game keeps the half. Fixed there and on Improved Mind Blast, Improved Arcane Shot, Improved Corruption, Bane and Fel Domination. Riposte, Resourcefulness, Demonic Brand and Berserking had a ? where a number belongs, those are filled in. Every rank of every talent was then checked line by line against Wowhead's beta data.
